# Mary Frances Early College of Education

> The Mary Frances Early College of Education at the University of Georgia offers comprehensive undergraduate and graduate programs in teacher education, counseling, and educational leadership with specialized concentrations and flexible delivery options.

UGA's College of Education serves students pursuing careers in teaching, educational administration, and related fields through traditional, online, and alternative certification pathways. The college provides extensive support services including academic advising, financial aid, and clinical field experiences.

## Key Topics

- Teacher Education
- Teacher Certification
- Graduate Programs (MEd, MAT)
- Undergraduate Programs (BSEd)
- Online Learning
- Financial Aid & Scholarships
- Academic Advising
- Clinical Practice & Student Teaching
- Professional Development
- Double Dawgs Combined Degree
- TESOL Certification
- Elementary Education
- English Education
- Kinesiology
- Workforce Education

## Academic Programs

- [Degree Programs](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/degrees): Comprehensive listing of undergraduate and graduate degree programs
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/undergraduate): Undergraduate education programs including Double Dawgs and teacher education
- [Graduate Programs](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/graduate): Graduate degree options in education, counseling, and administration
- [Online Programs](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/online): Online degrees and certificates through UGA Online platform
- [Concentrations](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/concentrations): Education degree concentrations including ASL and Applied Behavior Analysis
- [Non-Degree Programs](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/non-degree): Certificate programs and professional development options including TESOL

## Teacher Education & Certification

- [Want to Teach?](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/want-to-teach): Teacher education pathways including MAT and BSEd programs
- [Students in the Field](https://coe.uga.edu/academics/students-in-the-field): Clinical practice and student teaching field experience information
- [Certification Process for Out-of-State Graduates](https://coe.uga.edu/students/graduate-out-of-state-certification): Out-of-state teacher certification process for UGA graduates

## Student Support & Advising

- [Student Life](https://coe.uga.edu/students): Student life, organizations, financial aid, and academic advising resources
- [Undergraduate Advising](https://resources.coe.uga.edu/students/undergraduate-advising): Undergraduate advising resources, office hours, and SAGE registration
- [Financial Assistance](https://coe.uga.edu/students/financial-aid): Scholarships and financial aid information including HOPE Scholarship
- [Academic Standing](https://resources.coe.uga.edu/students/undergraduate-advising/academic-standing): Academic standing policies and Connect & Complete Persistence Framework
- [Transfer Students](https://coe.uga.edu/students/transfer-students): Transfer student admission requirements and Welcome UGA program

## College Organization & Events

- [Academics Overview](https://coe.uga.edu/academics): Overview of academic programs, degrees, and student engagement
- [Departments, Offices, and Units](https://coe.uga.edu/directory): Directory of departments, offices, and organizational structure
- [Conferences and Events](https://coe.uga.edu/events): Conferences, events, and professional development for College of Education
